newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes murderer of Shanghai novelist. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: China executes murderer of Shanghai novelist. [CORRECTED 13:30 GMT]

text.p: A restaurant worker has been executed for murdering a famous Shanghai novelist and her niece, the Liberation Daily reported on Saturday.
Tao Feng was executed on Friday after he was convicted of murder and robbery by the Shanghai Number Two Intermediate People's Court and his appeal turned down by a higher court, it said.
On August 25 this year, Tao entered Dai Houying's (corrects spelling) Shanghai apartment and killed her and her niece and stole money and valuables worth about $740, it said.
Tao, 27, worked at a restaurant in Jieshou city in the central province of Anhui, it said but gave no more details.
Dai was well-known in Shanghai for her novels and short stories dealing with the lives and emotions of local people.
